classes.label: Head Injury
classes.definition: An injury to the head that can result in serious consequences and is a leading cause of death in young males.
provenance: 1.Pipre 2003 - The BrainIT group concept and core dataset definition::chunk-0
classes.evidence: Head injury is a leading cause of death in young males and survivors have serious and long term morbidity.

classes.label: Cerebral Perfusion Pressure (CPP)
classes.definition: A physiological parameter measuring the pressure of blood flow to the brain, calculated as Blood Pressure minus Intracranial Pressure.
provenance: 1.Pipre 2003 - The BrainIT group concept and core dataset definition::chunk-0
1.Pipre 2003 - The BrainIT group concept and core dataset definition::chunk-5
classes.evidence: Over the last few years an interest in Cerebral Perfusion Pressure (CPP) targeted therapy for head injured patients has developed with a number of observational studies indicating that a Cerebral Perfusion Pressure (CPP) of 70 mmHg appears to be a critical value.

classes.label: Monitoring Data
classes.definition: Data collected continuously to assess the physiological status of patients, particularly in neuro-intensive care settings.
provenance: 1.Pipre 2003 - The BrainIT group concept and core dataset definition::chunk-0
1.Pipre 2003 - The BrainIT group concept and core dataset definition::chunk-5
1.Pipre 2003 - The BrainIT group concept and core dataset definition::chunk-6
classes.evidence: the technical aims of the group are to collect both monitoring and non-monitoring core dataset elements from multiple centers using bedside.

classes.label: GCS Assessment
classes.definition: A scale used to assess a patient's level of consciousness and neurological status.
provenance: 1.Pipre 2003 - The BrainIT group concept and core dataset definition::chunk-2
1.Pipre 2003 - The BrainIT group concept and core dataset definition::chunk-3
classes.evidence: Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) scores at both pre-neurosurgical hospital admission and at admission to the hospital with Neurosurgery.

classes.label: Computed Tomography (CT) Scan
classes.definition: An imaging technique used to visualize internal structures of the body, particularly the brain.
provenance: 1.Pipre 2003 - The BrainIT group concept and core dataset definition::chunk-2

classes.label: Heart Rate

classes.label: Respiration Rate
classes.definition: A physiological parameter measuring the number of breaths taken per minute, monitored using impedance plethmography or ventilator.

classes.label: SaO2

classes.label: CVP
